title: The roadmap build runs its session and pull rows with no threads list
why: A cloud triage has no thread tool. With no threads list, build.py reads every upkeep row unknown, though only Live work's thread count reads threads. Triage then passes threads: [], which shows a made-up zero.
note: Found  CST Nov 10 by triage at the live-file-archive-fields build: with no threads key, 9 rows read 'unknown (the live file has no threads list)', among them stalled step, ready not started and lanes to archive. Fix: those rows need only readAt, pulls, sessions and items; a missing threads list makes only the thread count unknown. Source: skills/roadmap/build.py on origin/main 0e6509a96.
